extracted.name: Homemade Vanilla Extract
extracted.description: Homemade vanilla extract! What could be better and cheaper!
instruction_lines: Place the vanilla beans in the bottle of vodka and seal. Store in a cool, dark area such as a kitchen cabinet for 3 weeks, shaking the bottle every week. Three weeks is the minimum, store it 6 months for the best flavor. After using, replace with more vodka. The same beans will continue to flavor the vanilla for up to a year.
